title: WebMCP discovery, invocation and registration use an obsolete native API contract
surface: Tools / WebMCP and extension page-tool registration
user_impact: A page implementing the currently documented native interface cannot be discovered, invoked or registered through the obsolete interface. Native browser reproduction remains pending; source-boundary failure is reproduced.
preconditions: Use exact pre-repair source and the documented-native-boundary test introduced by the repair worker. Keep the production resource guard enabled.
For native confirmation use an owned secure page and browser exposing documented document.modelContext; record exact browser/channel/enablement and extension artifact.
reproduction: Run the guarded tests/unit/webmcp-native-contract.test.ts against the pre-repair source.
Provide only document.modelContext with asynchronous getTools/executeTool and registerTool expecting execute; call the real extension handlers/registration.
Observe all three positive discovery/invocation/registration cases fail with WebMCP unavailable; the strict boundary intentionally supplies none of the obsolete navigator/tools/callTool/run aliases.
expected: Use the documented document.modelContext asynchronous discovery/execution and registration contract, preserving assigned-tab routing and authorization.
actual: Three guarded causal source cases fail on the pre-repair implementation. Current Chrome documentation contradicts namespace, method and callback assumptions. No native browser failure has yet been reproduced.
